incidents.label: Tor-only nodes lose peers network-wide (observed in gossip)
Fixes shipped (CLN, Eclair, LDK); LND 8 advisories

caveats: Gossip is one LND node's view of the public (announced) graph; private channels are not counted.
Node capacity counts each channel for both endpoints.
Chain data does not show which side broadcast a force close; mass-close events (one node in >= 20 force closes in a day) are separated from organic force closes.
A successful theft leaves no justice transaction; breach counts are a lower bound on attempts.
